metadata.title: Optimalen Nakup — verified offers without hidden influence
metadata.description: An evidence-first research agent for transparent, verifiable, and unbiased buying decisions.

hero.title: Less guessing. A better purchase.
hero.description: Optimalen Nakup reviews permitted sources, verifies important details, and shows why an offer deserves attention — including what could not be confirmed.
hero.neutral: No paid influence on organic ranking

proof.title: A recommendation you can verify
proof.subtitle: Every result separates confirmed data from inference, missing information, and conflicts.
proof.riskText: Accident history is not stated in the public offer.
proof.reasonText: It meets every hard requirement and has above-average evidence coverage.

categories.title: Initial research verticals
categories.vehiclesText: Price, mileage, equipment, seller, history, and risks.
categories.computersText: Exact SKU, processor, graphics, display, warranty, and delivered price.
categories.whiteGoodsText: Dimensions, energy, noise, delivery, installation, and old-appliance removal.

process.title: From a need to a defensible shortlist
process.oneText: Natural language becomes requirements, preferences, and exclusions.
process.twoText: Correct every filter and weight before research begins.
process.threeText: See sources, inspected pages, rejections, and warnings in real time.
process.fourText: Open evidence, score breakdowns, and direct source links.

pricing.title: Clear plans for different research depth
pricing.description: Public pricing is not approved yet. Join the closed beta and help shape fair pricing based on actual time saved.
pricing.starterText: Occasional individual research and essential comparison.
pricing.proText: More sources, deeper verification, monitoring, and exports.
pricing.businessText: Shared workspaces, collaboration, and higher limits.
